title.zh: 【渣打银行拟向新加坡机构投资者提供加密资产托管服务】
title.en: 【渣打银行拟向新加坡机构投资者提供加密资产托管服务】

current_state.zh: Standard Chartered plans to launch crypto asset custody services for institutional investors in Singapore, with segregated client holdings and traditional-asset-like legal protections, before expanding to the UAE, Luxembourg and Hong Kong from mid-2026.
current_state.en: Standard Chartered plans to launch crypto asset custody services for institutional investors in Singapore, with segregated client holdings and traditional-asset-like legal protections, before expanding to the UAE, Luxembourg and Hong Kong from mid-2026.
